common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Open Weights Capability Jump
common.line: An open-weight release lands within a few months of the closed frontier.

common.title: Safety Breakthrough
common.line: An interpretability or control result measurably improves assurance on systems already deployed, rather than on toy models – behaviour that can be predicted before it is observed, or a property that can be certified rather than argued for.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Ics toolkit proliferation
notable.line: Industrial-control-tuned open weights from the autumn grid intrusions are repackaged into a public toolkit, with step-by-step playbooks for grid and port systems circulating beyond the original actors.

notable.title: Gulf compute offer
notable.line: A Gulf sovereign fund publicly offers multi-billion co-financing for EU gigafactory power and data-centre build-out in exchange for guaranteed inference capacity and equipment-supply preferences.
